  "next_check":"id_check",
  "memo":"R08 holds because three accounts use the shipping address. Although it is the current home, its registered tenure does not satisfy the household exception. Linkage is the sole adverse family; no Context rule holds and no earlier outcome settles the order. Household sharing is the strongest benign explanation, while coordinated identities remain possible but uncorroborated. With no completed checks, recommend needs_check, implemented as a hold with id_check. Contact is not required. Identity and issuer authentication would resolve the current evidence; a shared address alone does not establish fraud."
